~/camille/about.md

cat about.md

Hardware, networks, and the trust between them

I'm a second-year engineering student in Computer Systems Engineering at South Mediterranean University (SMU MedTech). My work so far has crossed three layers: embedded and IoT devices, the networks that connect them, and the software that runs on top.

Working across those layers taught me where systems tend to break: weak links between devices, traffic nobody inspects, and code nobody checks before it ships. That is why I'm focusing on security, starting with network and software security and moving toward cloud security and identity and access management.

Selected work

Software Supply Chain Security

RUNNING
research · software · practical phase Dec 2026

My first research project: how malicious code gets injected into open-source software by users or contributors, and how to catch it before it reaches downstream projects.

  • Studying the open-source lifecycle and where untrusted contributions enter it
  • Reviewing AI-based code analysis tools for detecting injected malicious scripts
  • Exploring blockchain-based provenance as a complementary trust layer
  • Next: propose a detection approach and validate it on a simulated real-world case
supply-chainstatic-analysisai-code-analysisblockchain

MAC BANK SMU

EXITED 0
team project · network

A distributed banking application communicating over HTTP, built as a team to study what plaintext traffic exposes.

  • Captured and analyzed client–server traffic in Wireshark
  • Demonstrated a man-in-the-middle attack on unencrypted HTTP
  • Presented the findings and the case for TLS to the class
httpwiresharkmitmdistributed-systems

Part Counter V1

DEPLOYED
internship · embedded · FabLab SMU MedTech

An automated electronic-component counter running on a Raspberry Pi Zero W with a camera module.

  • Computer vision in Python and OpenCV: Otsu thresholding and contour-based counting
  • Flask server streaming live annotated video, plus a /count JSON endpoint
  • Headless setup over SSH; solved ARMv6 build issues by installing OpenCV from system packages
  • Extended with a 16×2 I2C LCD, GPIO status LEDs, and Telegram bot alerts
raspberry-pipythonopencvflaskgpio/i2c

SafeRide: Smart Helmet

EXITED 0
iot · raspberry pi · Mar 2025 · SMU Project Day

A smart motorcycle helmet built on a Raspberry Pi 4. It detects alcohol on the rider's breath (MQ-3) and sounds a buzzer, reads the heart rate (MAX30100), detects crashes with motion (MPU) and vibration (SW-420) sensors, and sends an emergency message through a GSM module. Built by a team of five and presented at SMU Project Day.

French Baccalaureate

~/camille/education/medtech
2023 → 2028 · SMU MedTech · Tunis

Engineering Cycle, Computer Systems Engineering

In 2023 I joined the Mediterranean Institute of Technology (MedTech), the engineering school of South Mediterranean University in Tunis, where I'm now in my second year of the Computer Systems Engineering program.

My weeks mix lectures and hands-on labs in computer networks, programming, embedded systems and IoT, digital design and signal processing. What I value most is learning by building: many of my projects, like SafeRide and CareWalk, started in class. Outside the classroom, the clubs, workshops and hackathons on campus have shaped my path toward cybersecurity.
